intro: Houston listings advertise 10x10 units from as little as $22 a month, while typical non-climate 10x10 market rates run about $93–$98/month. Houston is one of the cheapest big metros for storage, but once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, your six-month average still lands well above the number on the banner.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Climate-controlled ~$44–$46.
Walk-in closet; dorm or studio overflow. Lowest promo is from a single October listing (estimate). Climate-controlled ~$71–$75.
Most rented size. Houston metro non-climate average $95 (Storage Stats, Oct 2026), down 11.9% YoY, so there is room to negotiate. Climate-controlled ~$118–$128.
Two-bedroom contents. Lowest promo is from a single October listing (estimate). Climate-controlled ~$168–$180.
Three-bedroom house or a car. Climate-controlled ~$224–$245; outdoor/drive-up cheaper.

local_tips: Houston ranks 2nd among US metros by facility count (1,400+ tracked by Storage Stats) and 10x10 asking rents are down about 12% year over year, so competing quotes are easy to get.
StorageCafe data shows Houston rates are lowest around January and highest in August; if you can time a move-in, winter promos are usually better.
Prices swing a lot by neighborhood: Beechnut, Inverness Forest and Woodforest average about $89–$91 for a 10x10, while Inner Loop areas like River Oaks and Montrose can run $250+.
Extra Space charges a $50 admin fee (per StorageUnitCosts), higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
